news_items.headline: Costco April net sales rise 13% YoY to $23.92B for four weeks ended May 3
news_items.summary: Costco reported total net sales of $23.92B for the retail month of April (four weeks ended May 3, 2026), up 13% YoY, ahead of expectations. Sales partially driven by elevated fuel prices benefiting gas station operations.

news_items.headline: Prediction: Costco Will Trade At This Price In 1 Year
news_items.summary: 24/7 Wall St. published a one-year price prediction piece on COST citing the consensus analyst price target around $1,078 and implied modest upside.

news_items.headline: Catalyst Watch: Spotlight on the Fed, Costco earnings, and Nasdaq 100 additions
news_items.summary: Seeking Alpha flagged Costco's upcoming May 28 earnings report as a key near-term catalyst alongside Fed decisions and Nasdaq 100 index changes.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Most recent analyst actions came on April 9-10, 2026 from DA Davidson, Telsey Advisory Group, and Wells Fargo (priced in pre-window). No analyst-rating changes in last 7 days. Current consensus: 23 Buy / 12 Hold / 2 Sell across 27 analysts; MarketBeat consensus PT $1,070.54, 19-analyst consensus PT $1,078, implied ~6.6% upside.

earnings_context.notes: Fiscal Q3 2026 earnings expected May 28 with street modeling ~14% YoY EPS growth. Last quarter (Q2 FY26) beat both top and bottom lines: revenue ~$69.6B, diluted EPS $4.58. Street watching membership growth, comparable-sales momentum, and digital expansion.
